objective_value: <float> Total network cost, comprising target-to-Steiner assignment costs, spanning tree edge costs, and Steiner node activation costs.
active_steiner_nodes: <list[int]> Indices of the Steiner nodes selected for activation in the network.
assignments: <dict, key: '{target_node}'> Index of the active Steiner node to which each target node is connected.
steiner_tree_edges: <list[list[int]], shape [num_edges][2]> Pairs of active Steiner node indices connected by an edge in the spanning tree.
